description: Change a template's draft: name, subject, html, text or fallbacks. Sends keep using the published version until the template is published again. Null removes html or text; at least one must remain.

fallbacks.description: Replace every fallback. Pass {} to remove them all.

html.description: Replace the HTML body. Null removes it; html or text must remain.

idempotency_key.description: Optional idempotency key. If omitted, the MCP server generates one for POST tools.

text.description: Replace the plain-text body. Null removes it; html or text must remain.

name: shipmail_update_template

has_unpublished_changes.description: True when the draft differs from the published version, or nothing is published.

published_version.description: The version a send uses. Null until the first publish.

title: Update Template
